faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Kerala State Electricity Board Limited (KSEBL) for positions based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in KSEBL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered is General Manager (Environment) under the PSU sector on a deputation job type.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the General Manager (Environment) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the General Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech in Civil Engineering with a PG Degree in Environmental Engineering along with relevant environmental management experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for KSEBL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must download the form and submit it through the proper channel as instructed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form for the General Manager (Environment) position is 10-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: The salary and remuneration are provided strictly as per the deputation norms of the Government of Kerala (GoK).

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates send their completed applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent through the proper channel to The Managing Director, Vizhinjam International Seaport Limited, 9th Floor, KSRTC Bus Terminal Complex, Thampanoor, Thiruvananthapuram- 695001.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for submitting the offline application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can check the official website www.kseb.in or www.vizhinjamport.in to download the notification and application formats.
